inference: one minimum-threshold decode per weight; dev profiles filter these predictions. Final runs chosen threshold directly.
comparison: Primary M0/M1 pair uses the SAME selected threshold; labels, rules, policy, splitter, windowing and metric implementations fixed.

selection_rule.eligible: M1 dev critical micro recall and overall F1 >= paired M0; per-critical recall >= paired M0; normal block-or-error increase <=1 percentage point.
selection_rule.rank: Among eligible (M1 epoch, shared threshold) pairs maximize the minimum of M0/M1 overall F1, then M1 F1, then critical recall, then lower normal failure rate; deterministic epoch/threshold tie-break.
selection_rule.fallback: If no eligible pair, choose the highest ranked dev pair under the same objective, explicitly flag no dev gate pass; final validation may reject M1 and retain M0.

normal_failure_definition: B Gateway._inspect, including one reinspection; normal block OR fail-closed error. Both models use this new protocol.
dev_gateway_scope: normal documents only; residual scores on positive dev are first-pass diagnostics, not final gateway evaluation.
final_policy: After selection, run pinned official test and human-reviewed frozen service holdout once per selected model; no test-based retuning.
